convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for PriceChannel_Stop indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory). Custom indicator buffers must be understood to replicate signals.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is ready

other_exits: Opposing signal from PriceChannel_Stop buffer 4 (Up opposite) triggers SELL_Close when both SellPosOpen and SellPosClose are true
Opposing signal from PriceChannel_Stop buffer 1 (Down opposite) triggers BUY_Close when both BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose are true
Primary signal reversal: Up signal (buffer 3) closes sell positions if SellPosClose enabled; Down signal (buffer 0) closes buy positions if BuyPosClose enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots via MM parameter, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM=0.1 interpreted as 0.1 lots when LOT mode, or 10% of deposit in other modes.

custom_logic_notes: PriceChannel_Stop is a 5-buffer custom indicator. Buffers: 0=Down signal line, 1=Down opposite signal, 3=Up signal line, 4=Up opposite signal. Signal detected when buffer value is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE on bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous bar). Entry signal time is computed as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec. The EA has a Recount mechanism: if CopyBuffer fails, Recount=true forces recalculation on next tick. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. Opposite-signal close logic (buffers 1 and 4) only triggers close when both the open and close flags for that direction are enabled (e.g., SellPosOpen && SellPosClose for SELL_Close from Up opposite).
python_conversion_notes: The PriceChannel_Stop custom indicator must be replicated in Python - it is a Price Channel with stop levels based on Risk factor. The indicator computes upper/lower channel bounds from highest high/lowest low over ChannelPeriod bars, then offsets by Risk*ATR to generate stop levels. Buffers 0/3 are the signal lines (appear when price crosses the stop level), buffers 1/4 are opposite-direction signals. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose which handle order placement with deviation, SL/TP in points, and margin-based lot sizing. The MMMode enum logic for lot calculation must be reimplemented. The CIsNewBar class must be replicated for new-bar detection. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - 1000 points = 100 pips for 5-digit, 1000 points = 1000 pips for 4-digit; no explicit digit adjustment is present in the EA itself.
